name: Turso
description: Turso lets agents list and manage databases in a Turso Cloud account and run SQL against them. Each user signs in to their own Turso account through the browser.

prompts.text: List my Turso databases and the regions they run in.
Show the schema of the tables in the app database.
How many users signed up in the last seven days, from the users table?

apps.name: Turso
apps.description: Database management and SQL queries, over Turso's MCP server with browser sign-in.
